svg.title: Roofs, paving & reuse · Permeable paving
svg.desc: A vegetated roof retains water and supports evapotranspiration and roof drainage. Permeable paving admits water into aggregate voids, with subsoil and drainage checked separately. Source claims: source-control. Conceptual cutaways use diagram coordinates, not metre construction dimensions. Profiles, layer proportions, process arrow positions and vegetation arrangements are assistant illustration choices. No layer depths, capacities, tank sizes, rates or wet loads are derived from this geometry. Dashed infiltration is conditional on soil and groundwater; arrow lengths do not indicate rates. The separate source slope triangle alone is metric.
